```{r}
## 23/24

nba <- read.csv("23_24_Height.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", check.names = FALSE)
nba$height_cm <- height_to_cm(nba$HEIGHT)

stats <- read.csv("23_24.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", check.names = FALSE)
nba$KEY   <- toupper(trimws(nba$PLAYER))
stats$KEY <- toupper(trimws(stats$PLAYER))
nba <- merge(nba, stats[, c("KEY", "MIN")], by = "KEY")


elite <- filter_elite(nba, threshold = 25)
nrow(elite)

save(nba, elite, file = "12_DataSaving.RData")

plot(elite$height_cm, elite$PTS, pch = 16, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Height (cm)", ylab = "PPG",
     main = "Height vs PPG, Players Averaging 25+ PPG")
abline(lm(PTS ~ height_cm, data = elite), col = "red", lwd = 2)
cor(elite$height_cm, elite$PTS)

thresholds <- c(20, 25, 30)
sapply(thresholds, function(t) nrow(filter_elite(nba, threshold = t)))

elite <- filter_elite(nba, threshold = 25)

plot(elite$height_cm, elite$PTS,
     pch = 16, col = "steelblue", cex = 1.3,
     xlab = "Height (cm)", ylab = "Points per game (PPG)",
     main = "Height vs PPG: Players Averaging 25+ PPG, 2023-24",
     xlim = range(elite$height_cm) + c(-8, 8),   # extra room for names
     ylim = range(elite$PTS) + c(-1, 1))

# Label each point with the player's name
text(elite$height_cm, elite$PTS,
     labels = elite$PLAYER,
     pos = c(3, 1),
     cex = 0.7)

```

# Coding for What is the percentage of Players shorter than 6’5 feet? Year 24-25
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("24_25_Height.csv")
```

```{r}
df_processed <- df %>%
  separate(HEIGHT, into = c("feet", "inches"), sep = "-", convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(HEIGHT_CM = (feet * 12 + inches) * 2.54)
```


```{r}
total_count <- nrow(df_processed)
short_count <- df_processed %>% filter(HEIGHT_CM < 195.58) %>% nrow()
percentage  <- (short_count / total_count) * 100
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== 2024-2025 NBA Season Height Analysis (CM) ===\n")
cat("Total Players in Dataset:               ", total_count, "\n")
cat("Players Shorter than 195.58 cm (6'5\"): ", short_count, "\n")
cat("Percentage Shorter than 6'5\":         ", round(percentage, 2), "%\n")
```

#Coding for What is the number of players that have scored 25+ points per game? Year 24-25
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
getwd()
```

```{r}
df_2425 <- read_csv("24_25.csv")
```

```{r}
high_scorers <- df_2425 %>%
  filter(PTS >= 25)
```

```{r}
total_players <- nrow(df_2425)
count_25plus  <- nrow(high_scorers)
pct_25plus    <- (count_25plus / total_players) * 100
```

```{r}
cat("=== 2024-2025 NBA Season: 25+ PPG Analysis ===\n")
cat("Total Players Analyzed:              ", total_players, "\n")
cat("Players Scoring 25+ Points Per Game: ", count_25plus, "\n")
cat("Percentage of Players (25+ PPG):     ", round(pct_25plus, 2), "%\n\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Players with 25+ PPG:\n")
print(high_scorers %>% select(PLAYER, TEAM, PTS))
```
